diffuseAlbedo.source: Palette.json: accent.pierre-bleue research.needed (no substance record yet)
diffuseAlbedo.note: A first blue-grey for a honed crinoidal limestone of the Soignies basin, read from trade photographs.

refractiveIndex.source: Substances/cream-marble.json: optics.specularF0 (0.0533, calcite grains in random orientations)
refractiveIndex.derivation: n = (1 + sqrt(F0)) / (1 - sqrt(F0)), the index whose normal-incidence reflectance is the record's F0

porosity.source: Les Carrieres de la Pierre Bleue Belge SA (Soignies), 'Belgian Blue Stone' brochure (2022), Technical characteristics table, p. 11: Porosity 0.24 % vol, standard deviation 0.15, n = 244 (NBN EN 1936:2007); water absorption 0.10 % m (NBN EN 13755:2008); apparent bulk density 2690 kg/m3; capillary absorption (NBN EN 1925) 'Not applicable, due to the low porosity of the stone', https://www.pierrebleuebelge.be/en/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2022/12/Pierre-Bleue-Belge-Brochure-Belgian-Blue-Stone.pdf
porosity.note: Verified. It agrees with UBAtc ATG 00/H724 (S.A. Carrieres du Hainaut, Soignies, 2000): porosity under vacuum 0.28 % vol, s = 0.13, n = 131 (NBN B24-213), averaged over the Soignies and Condroz basins, https://api.butgb-ubatc.be/api/public/file/ATG00H724F_000114A_1.pdf. I did not open Pereira et al. 2015, so it is dropped from the note.

grain.source: Debout L. & Denayer J. (2018) 'Palaeoecology of the Upper Tournaisian (Mississippian) crinoidal limestones from South Belgium', Geologica Belgica 21(3-4):111-127: in the Soignies Member at the Gauthier-Wincqz quarry 'The columnal diameter fluctuates between 0.2 to 10 mm'; histograms polymodal (Fig. 11), https://popups.uliege.be/1374-8505/index.php?id=5991
grain.note: Verified. The paper gives the 0.2 to 10 mm range for the Soignies Member beds, which it names as the Gros dur, Cul de Poupli, Banc dit de 3 metres and so on, the same beds as the ATG quarry log. It reports polymodal histograms and gives no numerical mode or mean, so the geometric mean of the range is a stand-in. UBAtc ATG 00/H724 describes the stone as innumerable crinoid articles cemented in microcrystalline calcite.
grain.derivation: Geometric mean of the measured range of columnal diameters: sqrt(0.2 mm x 10 mm) = 1.41 mm

bed.note: A first value for the band or bed a honed face shows, until a specimen is measured.

bedAspect.note: How much finer the veining is across its run than along it, read from trade photographs.

hurst.source: Candela et al. 2012, Journal of Geophysical Research 117, B08409 (fault surfaces, 0.6 to 0.8; cited in Stone.ush)
hurst.note: The middle of the range measured on rock surfaces, as the travertine's.

toneSpread.note: A first half-range of ln(albedo) across a face, from its veins and clasts.

roughnessSpread.source: Workings/honed.json: unverified surface.microRoughness (no filtered roughness read)
roughnessSpread.note: A first half-range of ln(roughness) across a honed face, as the travertine's.
